name: Communication Essentials
description: Tactful, high-EQ communication coaching for Chinese social and workplace contexts: graceful refusals, comfort without hollow advice, apologies, subtext decoding, and workplace reporting scripts.
description_zh: 面向中文社交与职场场景的高情商沟通教练：得体拒绝、不说空话的安慰、具体道歉、潜台词解读，以及职场汇报话术。
